manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0086; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: The second stop and Take the second turn are natural bounded A1 uses of ordinal second.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps second to دوم in the route context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast order words and unrelated familiar language without duplicating the answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances remain short and early-A1 appropriate.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second use changes from a stop label to a route instruction.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, target, turns, activities and outcome all align.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded ordinal A1 sense is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at the text gate.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
resolvedFindings: Persian orthography and meaning are coherent.
